about: Known exceptions for the registry_id tests (tests/test_registry_ids.py). Every entry needs a reason. registry_id is the id of the government body in BetaNYC/ny-gov-web-registry data/registry.json; the ids this repo accepts are in ny-gov-web-registry-ids.json.

places_not_linked_to_a_locality.reason: The City of New York is not an entity in ny-gov-web-registry, by design: its docs/sources.md says the borough presidents and the existing NYC entities stand for it. This row is NYC Open Data, so it points to oti, the Office of Technology and Innovation, which runs it.

shared_ids.reason: The New York City row (NYC Open Data) and the OTI rows (the NYC API portal and NYC's map hub) all point to oti, the office that runs those sites.

Rows from different CUNY colleges, libraries and centers (Baruch, Lehman, John Jay, the Graduate Center, CUNY Libraries) all point to cuny: per Noel's 2026-11-13 decision on BetaNYC/ny-gov-web-registry#58, public universities link at the system level.

Rows from different SUNY campuses, libraries and centers (System Administration, Albany, Binghamton, Stony Brook, ESF, Cortland, the Rockefeller Institute) all point to suny: per Noel's 2026-11-13 decision on BetaNYC/ny-gov-web-registry#58, public universities link at the system level.

held_for_review.reason: Not linked, per Noel's 2026-11-13 decision: the site is run by multi-agency State working groups and names no single agency (checked in a browser on 2026-11-13). ny-gov-web-registry lists the host under the Department of State; the row names the Department of Environmental Conservation. Link only if a page names the agency that runs it.

private_not_linked.reason: Private universities, libraries, research centers and nonprofits are not linked. Per Noel's 2026-11-13 decision on BetaNYC/ny-gov-web-registry#58, public universities and public libraries link to ny-gov-web-registry and private ones do not.
